title: Parts import updates an inactive part in place and keeps it inactive
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPINACT-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with Min 1 and Max 5, and is inactive.
  • Parts import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPINACT.csv) has one row for {Part-A} with the same number, description, category, bin and quantity, and Min 3.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory, upload {File-A} and run the import.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, Active tab, and search {Part-A}.
  3. Click the Inactive tab and search {Part-A}.
  4. Open the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The import finishes without errors.
  • Step 2: {Part-A} is not on the Active tab.
  • Step 3: {Part-A} is listed once (one row, no second copy).
  • Step 4: Min reads 3 and the title row pill reads "Inactive".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-E8, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows the import.
